name: Arrow of Vengeance, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 4, inquisitor 5, lathspell 4, paladin 4, ranger 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as arrow of vengeance except that if it hits it is automatically a critical hit and it deals extra damage equal to 1/2 your caster level in addition to your Wisdom or Charisma bonus.
